content.caption: Tall dark-trunked trees with layered green crowns stand on a sunlit grassy slope, with a grey-roofed building and a few more trees further off under a pale sky. The telescope itself is not visible in this frame; only the island's trees and hill are.
content.opinion: The photograph shows trees and grass rather than the telescope I meant to record, which is a poor showing, but the hill is nicely lit and I will allow it.
